verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for a filing portal, but the evidence describes only interactive web use: online dashboards, FranceConnect+ login and qualified e-signature certificates. Nothing documents a Guichet unique API, CLI or headless filing path. The keyless JSON API in the probe belongs to a separate state company-search service (recherche-entreprises), not to the Guichet unique, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
